Parent: #47

Replace `read-issue` and `preflight-{name}` agents with workflow-native code in ship.js.

## Changes
- Use `gh issue view #{issue} --json title,body,labels` via exec() and parse JSON directly
- Run SSH pre-flight via exec() — no agent needed for `ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5`
- Parse issue body for SCs with regex (already structured format)

## Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-1: Goal phase has 0 LLM agents (currently 2-3)
- [ ] SC-2: Goal phase completes in <15s (currently ~2-5 min)
- [ ] SC-3: Issue data extraction parity — same fields, same values
- [ ] SC-4: Pre-flight checks produce identical reachable/unreachable results

## Key file
`workflows/ship.js` — the Goal phase section
title: Pipeline optimization Phase 1: Goal Determinism
